tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dkyil 'khor spros bcas ming gi rim pa bzhugs so/ /

bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal te/ /dkyil 'khor spraus bcas nang gzhug pa'i/ /ming gi rim pa gsal byed pa/ /'di nyid du ni rab bshad bya/ /de yang thog ma'i 'od gsal snying po ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin las/ rang nyid gang gtso bo dang nye ba'i dkyil 'khor gang yin brtag pa'i phyir me tog dor ba las/ dbus su babs na chos dbyings ye shes/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rnam par snang mdzad las dras te/ gnas lugs mtshon pa'i ming gdags pa ni/ sna tshogs rang grol/ chos nyid dri med/ lhun grub rgyal po/ 'gyur med ye shes/ mkha' klong yangs pa/ mi dmigs chos nyid/ ye grol gnyug ma/ lhun mnyam bya bral/ kun byed rgyal po/ klong chen rab 'byams/ mkha' mnyam chos sku/ gzhi bral chos nyid/ bsam rdzogs rgyal po/ brjod med mtshon 'das/ byang chub snying po/ gnyug ma khyab gdal/ ye stong rtsa bral/ kun grol ye shes/ ma lus chos nyid/ rol pa ye shes/ gang shar rang grol/ ye grol 'dzin med/ ma btsal rang rdzogs/ byar med rang byung*/ sangs rgyas rang chas/ mi 'gyur lhun grub/ khyab gdal chen po/ snang srid chos sku/ rtsal chen rdzogs pa la sogs te/ dbyings 'pho 'gyur med pa las dras te/ skyes pa dang bud med gang 'os su gdags so/ shar du babs na/ me long ye shes rdo rje'i rigs mi bskyod pa las dras te/ 'od gsal mtshon pa'i ming la/ rdo rje snying po/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje legs pa/ 'od lnga lhun grub/ ye shes dri med/ rang shar 'od gsal/ lhun mnyam mi g.yo/ /phyam cig byang chub/ gsal stong 'dzin med/ rang gsal chos sku/ ma lus lhun grub/ gdod nas byang chub/ dmigs bsam spros bral/ 'gag med rang gsal/ rang byung ye shes/ 'od gsal snying po/ gnyis med ye shes/ phyogs med rang yan/ dmigs med kun grol/ yangs pa chen po/ 'gro ba chos nyid/ bsam rdzogs gdod ma/ byar med nam mkha'/ ma skyes chos nyid/ mi gnas rang byung*/

mi 'ong ye shes/ rol pa 'gag med/ rgya yan rang grol/ mtha' bral dbu ma/ rdzogs pa rang byung*/ rig pa dri med/ rang shar 'gag med/ mtha' bral klong chen la sogs te/ gsal dngas 'od gsal las dras te/ gang 'os su gdags so/ /lhor babs na/ mnyam nyid ye shes rin chen rigs rin 'byung las brtsams te/ gnyis med mtshon pa'i ming la/ 'dod yon rang shar/ rgya chen dpal 'byor/ yon tan rang byung*/ bsam rdzogs rgyal po/ tshogs chen lhun rdzogs/ 'dod dgu rang shar/ yid bzhin snying po/ dpe med rang grol/ don grub snying po/ zhing khams rnam dag /lhun grub ye shes/ ma byas rang rdzogs/ gzhi med chos nyid/ ye shes rgyas pa/ chos nyid ngag dbang*/ klong rdzogs rgyal po/ /rang byung klong rgyal/ rol pa rang shar/ gang shar chos nyid/ cir snang mnyam grol/ blang dor gnyis med/ gtad med yongs grol/ sku gsum rang rdzogs/ ye shes lnga ldan/ gzugs sprin snying po/ ye shes nyi ma/ lhun grub gza' skar la sogs te/ gnyis su med pa'i mingalas brtsams te gdags so/ lho nub du babs na/ padma'i rigs 'od dpag med kun rtog ye shes kyi ming las/ bde chen rgyal po/ khams gsum yongs grol/ ma bsam chos nyid/ cir snang ye shes/ lhun mnyam bde chen/ padma klong chen/ klong gsal dri med/ bde chen rang byung*/ thams cad babs bde/ gzhi bde rang gsal/ 'gro ba byang chub/ thams cad chos nyid/ 'khor 'das ye grol/ ma spangs yongs rdzogs/ rang gsal bde chen/ 'od gsal klong rgyal/ byang chub rang byung*/ mkha' mnyam bde chen/ gzhi rtsa byang chub/ gang byung chos nyid/ yod med mtha' bral/ yangs dog gnyis med/ chos sku rang lugs/ mi dmigs phyam gdal la sogs te/ ye shes rang gsal gyi ming rnams gdags so/ /byang du babs na/ bya grub ye shes kyi rigs don yod grub pa las brtsams te/ sgo lnga bya bral/ lhun rdzogs chos sku/ rang shar ris med/ 'jig med rgyal po/ ma lus yongs grol/

kun mnyam yangs pa/ lhun mnyam yongs grol/ phyam gcig sangs rgyas/ ye nas byar med/ bya bral kun grol/ khyab gdal chos nyid/ phrin las lhun grub/ yongs rdzogs byang chub/ rang gzhan don grub/ ma spangs yongs rdzogs/ rtsol sgrub byar med/ chos sku rang rdzogs/ lhun grub 'dzin med/ yongs grol chen po la sogs te/ phyogs yan re dogs dang bral ba'i ming rnams gdags so/ /shar lhor babs na/ rang rdzogs gnyis med kyi ye shes mtshon pa'i ming la/ rang grol chos dbyings/ 'gyur med lhun grub/ ye grol klong yangs/ kun mnyam klong chen/ mkha' mnyam klong chen/ mkha' klong kun mkhyen/ gzhi rdzogs mtshon 'das/ byang chub phyam gdal/ ye grol rol pa/ gang shar rtsal rdzogs/ ma btsal rang byung*/ 'dzin med rang shar/ lhun grub khyab gdal/ snang srid rtsal chen/ phyam gdal ye shes/ mi g.yo byang chub/ gdod nas yongs grol/ 'khor 'das ye grol/ gzhi rtsa rnam dag /phyogs med kun grol/ chos nyid bsam rdzogs/ byar med rdzogs pa/ 'gro 'ong ye zad/ snang srid rgya yan/ gzhi rtsa rang shar/ 'gag med yongs grol/ chos zad blo 'das la sogs pa/ dbus dang shar lho'i ming rnams bsres la gdags so/ /lho nub tu babs na/ chos sku rang shar/ 'khor ba ye zad/ rdzogs chen rang shar/ bsam rdzogs snying po/ gzhi bde klong rgyas/ gang shar mnyam grol/ gtad med phyogs yan/ kun grol klong chen/ phyal pa bar med/ rgya grol nam mkha'/ gang bsam chos nyid/ lhun mnyam gdod ma/ rang shar gzhi bzhag /ye rdzogs lhun grub/ chos sku rang lugs/ ma bzhag rang grol/ ye bzhag gdengs chen/ rgya yan phyam gdal/ snang mnyam stong mnyam/ ma 'gags rang shar/ rgya yan gtad med/ phyogs mnyam yongs grol/ lhun grub gdod ma/ gang shar ye zad/ rtsal chen yongs rdzogs/ klong gsal rgya grol/ 'khor 'das rang snang*/ kun grol gzhir snang*/ thams cad ye rdzogs/ ye stong rtsa bral la sogs pa dbus dang lho nub kyi ming rnams bsres la gdags so/

/nub byang du babs na/ shar grol gnyis med kyi ye shes mtshon pa'i ming la/ sgo lnga rang grol/ gzung 'dzin ris med/ yul med rang shar/ yongs grol kun mnyam/ lhun mnyam phyam gdal/ byar med yi zin/ kun grol ye grub/ rang rdzogs shar grol/ yongs rdzogs byar med/ chos sku ye shar/ snang srid ye zad/ yongs grol klong chen/ cir snang chos nyid/ med snang gzugs brnyan/ lhun mnyam klong chen/ gdal khod ye snyoms/ chos zad ming zad/ ye grub rang rdzogs/ ye stong rang shar/ gzhi bde rang snang*/ thams cad lhun mnyam/ rdzogs pa spyi chings/ sna tshogs rang shar/ gzhi bral mkha' mnyam/ klong gsal lhun rdzogs/ gtad med phyogs 'byams/ rgyu 'bras ye grol/ sgrub med rtsal dkrugs/ klong chen ye gdal/ gtad med rgyal grol/ shar grol babs stong*/ mnyam rdzogs byar med/ ye zin rang babs/ chos nyid byar med/ zang thal chig rdzogs/ ye zin phyam gdal la sogs pa dbus dang nub byang gi ming rnams bsres la gdags so/ /byang shar du babs na/ zang thal chos zad kyi ye shes mtshon pa'i ming la/ chos sku ye shar/ lhun grub rang gsal/ 'khor ba gzhi grol/ byang chub rang chas/ srid gsum ye grol/ ma byas don grub/ ma 'bad ye phyin/ / bgrod med rang bzhag /gzhi mnyam yangs pa/ mkha' mnyam rang rig / zang ma thal byung*/ tha mal rang grol/ babs bzhag lhug pa/ gdal khod rang snyoms/ ma spangs rang grol/ ma btsal ye grub/ kun rdzogs chos sku/ gtad med rgya grol/ gang shar gdod ma/ rang gsal 'dzin med/ chos zad 'dzin med/ chos nyid yongs rdzogs/ gdal khyab ye grol/ rang byung gzhi klong*/ byang chub rang shar/ ye shes nyi ma/ rgya mtsho klong rdol/ mnyam rdzogs chu bo/ ye gdal rang yan/ spang blang ye grol/ snang sems yul med/ chos zad rang babs/ gdod ma mngon 'gyur/ gang snang kun grol/ ye stong yongs stong*/ phyogs 'byams byar med/ rang bzhag ye bde/ mkha' mnyam yongs rdzogs/ dran pa rang sangs/

har ba bar med/ phyal ba lhun grub la sogs pa/ dbus dang byang shar gyi ming rnams bsres la gdags so/ /mkha' dbyings rnam dag klong chen rgyal po yis/ /mi g.yo 'gags pa med pa'i ming brjod pas/ /'khor 'das ming tsam 'bad med yongs grol te/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i bkra shis shog /ming gi rigs byed mchog tu gsang ba ye shes bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ dbyings mthun pa dbang gi chu bo rgya mtsho las theg pa mchog gi pha rol du son pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ sna tshogs rang grol gyis gnas dka' ba bye brag tu bshad pa rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /dge'o/ dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (11)dkyil 'khor spros bcas ming gi rim pa/ -PAGE 64--PAGE 65--PAGE 62-
